name: A55

Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (side-mounted), proximity sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, IPX4 splash resistance

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 11 + ColorOS 11.1, Current: Android 13 + ColorOS 13.1
Platform.CPU: MediaTek MT6765 Helio G35 (12 nm), Octa-core (4×2.3 GHz Cortex-A53 & 4×1.8 GHz Cortex-A53)

Display.Display: Type: IPS LCD at 480 nits (typ) to 550 nits (peak) , Size: 6.51 inches, 102.3 cm2 (~82.6% screen-to-body ratio) , Resolution: 720 x 1600 pixels, 20:9 ratio (~270 ppi density)

Cameras.Rear camera: 50 MP, f/1.8, 26 mm (wide-angle), PDAF + 2 MP GalaxyCore GC02K0, f/2.4, (macro) + 2 MP GalaxyCore GC02M1B, f/2.4, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, 3.5 mm Audio, Bluetooth 5.0 (A2DP, LE, aptX), NFC, FM radio, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BDS, QZSS
